name: Grinning Gus
bio: Lost his face somewhere in the trenches and kept the grin. Still salutes anyone with a higher rank, or a pulse.
notes: A Meshy community model, CC0 per the owner (from the owner's Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch; the community model's name as the download names it): a textured GLB in a T-pose, not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A zombie soldier with a bare skull (dark metal in the download; only its colour is kept here) and red eyes, a plate carrier and torn trousers. 2026-11-03: finish.maps: the download's skull is black chrome from its metal-roughness map (built matte white before). A variant of Dog Tag Doyle since 2026-11-26 (owner: one character with variant looks, like the chimp's; this id kept, so a saved pick plays this look on Dog Tag Doyle's picker).

source.author: Meshy community (author not recorded; CC0 per the owner)
